title: Reversed exactness of the specified étale Hom transpose
statement: Let X,A→B,F and the canonical binary tensor comparison be as in [lem-coef-etale-tensor-model-comparison]. For any M in D(X_et,A), let v:F RHom_A(-,M)→RHom_B(F(-),FM) be a natural transformation satisfying the evaluation-transpose equation IsEtaleHomTranspose. Then v satisfies IsEtaleHomReversedExact: both contravariant Hom functors have coherent evaluation-normalized shifts with factor (-1)^(n(n+1)/2), the composite source and target shifts are precisely the specified scalar/Hom shifts, both functors are triangulated with these structures, and v commutes with those shifts. This concerns only exactness of an already given v, not its construction or its thick isomorphism locus.

source.place: Tags 08JA, 08J9 and 08JC: Hom model, evaluation and contravariant exactness

proof.text: Use a K-injective model I of M and flat-term K-flat representatives P of K. For the Hom differential d(f)=d_I f-(-1)^j f d_P, source reindexing by -n with factor (-1)^(n*j+n*(n+1)/2) in degree j is a chain isomorphism. Its evaluation transpose is the specified signed tensor-shift cancellation. The identity epsilon(a+b)=(-1)^(a*b)epsilon(a)epsilon(b) cancels tensor-shift interchange, giving coherent CommShift structures for both coefficient Hom functors.

Hom of a cone is the reversed cone, with the negative connecting projection; therefore the same normalized shifts are triangulated. The published internal Hom is identified with this Hom model by the normalized tensor-Hom adjunction. Derived scalar extension is triangulated with the adjoint-mate scalar shift. Compose these structures; their components are the two formulas for chiPhi and chiPsi in IsEtaleHomReversedExact.

Transpose the shift square for v using its given evaluation equation. Both transposes are evaluation after ordinary scalar balancing; the normalized binary comparison identifies them on flat-term K-flat models, with coefficients in degree zero and no new sign. Naturality and localization extend equality to every derived object. Injectivity of the tensor-Hom bijection proves the shift square, including the reversed connecting arrow.

theorem etaleHomComparison_reversedExact
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (φ : A →+* B) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (v : EtaleHomLeft X φ M ⟶ EtaleHomRight X φ M)
    (hv : IsEtaleHomTranspose X φ M v) : IsEtaleHomReversedExact X φ M v
